description:
Books worth sharing. Commissions worth creating for.

Ethiopian Bible Library Affiliate Program

Your audience comes to you for the next interesting read. Introduce them to the five-volume Ethiopian Bible Library — and earn from the orders your content brings in.

Earn 50% commission

One full-price $299 US library sale earns you $149.50. Earn 50% on orders delivered to the USA, UK, Canada or Australia, and 30% for other supported destinations.

Your commission includes the library, multi-set purchases and paid add-ons in the order. This funnel recorded $320+ average order value across 87 paid orders, September 2–8, 2026.

One library. Plenty of reasons to press record.

A closer look at Enoch. A tour of the five volumes. The next book on your reading list. A thoughtful gift for someone who loves biblical books. Choose the story your audience will want to watch.

The creative work starts with a head start

  • Product footage and images ready to bring into your next video.
  • Script examples and opening ideas to adapt to your own voice.
  • Clean source images and AI prompts for narrated videos, new scenes and carousels.
  • One Ethiopian Bible reading copy for selected creator partners, with assets to introduce the complete five-volume collection.

Make it a series. Keep earning from the sales.

Start with an introduction. Turn a viewer’s question into your next video. Explore another volume. Share a new reading angle. Your personal link connects the sales to you as you keep creating.

Instagram Reels, YouTube videos and Shorts, book blogs and newsletters all have a place here. Choose the format you enjoy and build on what your audience responds to.

Get your link. Choose your angle. Start sharing.

Join the program, verify your email and open your affiliate account. Your link and Creator Studio are ready for you. Interested in a reading copy? Tell us about your channel and the video you would love to make.

Get my affiliate link · Explore Creator Studio · See the five-volume library

Program details and payout information
payout_period: PayPal payouts every month, by the 15th for eligible balances. Full payment dates and details are in the program guide.
